entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You're speaking with Charlie at VeloFit, agent ID 402. How can I help you today?
Hi Charlie. I'm calling because I need to return my VeloBand Pulse HR monitor.
I can certainly look into that for you. May I have your name and order number to pull up your account?
Yes, the name is Sarah Jenkins, and the order number is... VF709-331-8B.

Thank you, Sarah. One moment... Okay, I see your order for the VeloBand Pulse, delivered on December 15th, 2025. To make sure I understand the situation correctly, is it a technical fault with the band or is this more of a preference issue?

Oh, it works fine. To be honest, I just... I **changed my mind**. It was a total **impulse buy** right when it came out, and I just **don't use it** like I thought I would. I feel so guilty about it, I really needed that money back for some other things.
I understand completely. Let me just take a moment to review the return eligibility for your order.
Please, I hope you can help. I've been a VeloFit customer for a long time. I just really don't want to go through the hassle of a **resale** website or something like that.

Thank you for your patience, Sarah. I've just consulted our policy. I can see the band was delivered 37 days ago, and our system shows that all our items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery.
Wait, really? So I can return it?

Yes, absolutely. You're well within the timeframe. I've gone ahead and approved the return for you. I'm sending a prepaid shipping label to the email address on file right now. Do you still have the original packaging?
Oh my gosh, yes, I have everything. That's fantastic news! Charlie, you've been a huge help. I was so worried.

You're very welcome, Sarah. Just pack it up, attach that label, and drop it off. Once our warehouse receives the item, your full refund will be processed back to your original payment method within 3-5 business days. Can I help with anything else today?
Nope, that was it! Thank you so much again.
It was my pleasure. Have a great day, and thank you for being a VeloFit customer.
